intervention.matched_budget: four equal-capacity adapters, each trained for 2000 steps in each of five frozen seed blocks on the same 600 Haze4K training-role scenes; all cells and the official baseline evaluated on 55 development-only original clear scenes in each of four domains
intervention.primary_variable: observable proxy class by training-and-evaluation spatial alignment
intervention.reference: The independently trained same-proxy permuted cell is the primary actionability reference; official ConvIR-B is the absolute-utility and safety reference.

primary_estimand.aggregation: For physics and uncertainty separately, average nested haze observations within each scene-seed, subtract the independently trained permuted-cell PSNR from aligned-cell PSNR without clipping, average the five frozen seed effects within original clear scene, compute each of four domain scene means, then average the four means equally. Selection uses only the frozen favorable and 0.005 dB near-tie rule.

question: Does spatially aligned inference-observable proxy information improve frozen-ConvIR daytime dehazing because its location is actionable during training, and is that effect transferable across proxy classes, five training seeds, and four development-only domains without near-clear or negative-tail harm?

research_update_binding.bottleneck_statement: Archived evidence rejects C1's aligned-versus-global-sham factorization and the Frozen-BN density-consistency-CARL intervention but does not identify whether an observable proxy's spatial location becomes useful when both aligned and distribution-preserving permuted conditions are independently optimized across seeds and domains.

decision_design.alias_structure: The official baseline is outside the 2x2 trained factorial. Within the four trained cells, proxy-class and alignment main effects, their interaction, and both proxy-specific simple alignment effects are fully estimable and unaliased. The scientific primary is the two simple alignment effects because a nonzero interaction makes an averaged alignment main effect insufficient. Each aligned-versus-official contrast bundles proxy content with aligned training and is an absolute-utility control, not a substitute for the actionability contrast.

arms.description: Official frozen ConvIR-B without an adapter.
Physics-proxy adapter independently trained and evaluated with deterministic within-scene joint spatial permutation.
Physics-proxy adapter independently trained and evaluated with aligned dark-channel, saturation, local-contrast, and gradient maps.
Transformation-disagreement adapter independently trained and evaluated with deterministic within-scene joint spatial permutation.
Transformation-disagreement adapter independently trained and evaluated with aligned frozen-ConvIR RGB disagreement plus disagreement luminance.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: Any frozen physics impossibility condition is reached.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: The simultaneous overall lower bound exceeds 0.10 dB with at least three positive domain lower bounds, no negative domain upper bound, absolute aligned utility, and four-of-five positive seed support.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: Any frozen uncertainty-proxy impossibility condition is reached.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: The simultaneous overall lower bound exceeds 0.10 dB with at least three positive domain lower bounds, no negative domain upper bound, absolute aligned utility, and four-of-five positive seed support.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: Neither simple actionability effect is material and interaction summaries provide no surviving differentiated mechanism.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: The simultaneous interaction summaries distinguish common spatial actionability from proxy-specific or domain-specific actionability.

mechanism_estimands.falsifier: Any decisive domain, seed, near-clear, or tail-risk condition is unfavorable or unsafe.
mechanism_estimands.prediction: The predeclared selected favorable proxy passes all frozen domain, seed, near-clear, and tail-risk controls.

decision_design.multiplicity_control: One terminal family contains exactly 16 simultaneous two-sided intervals: for each proxy, its aligned-minus-permuted overall interval and four domain intervals (10); for each proxy, its aligned-minus-official overall interval (2); and the physics-minus-uncertainty actionability interaction in each domain (4). Bonferroni familywise alpha 0.05 gives critical value 2.9551668474978343. Safety uses conservative componentwise intersection-union decisions at the same critical value; no safety component can rescue a failed scientific gate.

boundaries.futility: There is no interim scientific futility look. At terminal, both proxies satisfying an impossibility condition is a decisive scientific FAIL.
boundaries.precision: At terminal, any of the 16 simultaneous interval half-widths above 0.39 dB is inconclusive-only and cannot change a decisive scientific FAIL.
boundaries.success: Only the completed terminal look may produce favorable actionability, and every decisive gate plus formal precision must satisfy its frozen condition for PASS.
boundaries.validity: Any trigger, program, role, protected-access, model, asset, roster, scene, unit, output, integrity, or exact-ledger failure activates the validity veto and yields an inconclusive terminal rather than scientific FAIL.

design_selection.decision_value: Four independently trained proxy-class by alignment cells separate proxy content, spatial location, and their interaction; the official baseline, five seed blocks, four equal-weight domains, and safety summaries discriminate optimization artifacts, domain concentration, and harm.
design_selection.expected_time_to_decision: One protected-data-free exact-production capability phase followed, only if later authorized, by one bounded development run and one terminal outcome look; no interim scientific outcome access or result-adaptive extension is permitted.
design_selection.shared_setup: All four trained cells share the frozen official backbone and checkpoint, adapter architecture and initialization, Haze4K roster, distinct-scene batches, optimizer, loss, step count, crops, five seeds, evaluation rosters, nesting, and uncertainty method.
design_selection.worst_case_stopping_cost: The capability contract executes the exact 41100-iteration production map within 43200 seconds; a later scientific run, if separately authorized, is capped at 259200 seconds and 1501 SHA-bound workload units. There is no earlier scientific stopping look.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: A proxy-specific aligned-minus-permuted equal-domain lower bound exceeds 0.10 dB, at least three domain lower bounds exceed zero, no domain upper bound is negative, the aligned arm exceeds official ConvIR-B by more than 0.05 dB, and at least four of five seed-block effects are positive with none at or below -0.10 dB.
hypotheses.falsifier: For both proxies, any frozen impossibility condition holds: the actionability upper bound is at most 0.10 dB, the aligned-versus-official upper bound is at most 0.05 dB, a domain upper bound is negative, no more than two seed blocks are positive, or a seed block is at or below -0.10 dB.
hypotheses.statement: For at least one frozen proxy class, preserving spatial location during both training and evaluation yields material utility beyond an independently trained within-scene joint permutation with the same four-channel marginal distribution.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The physics-minus-uncertainty actionability interaction and the two simultaneous simple effects identify whether actionability is shared, physics-dominant, or uncertainty-dominant without attributing a selected gain to parameter count.
hypotheses.falsifier: Both simultaneous simple-effect intervals exclude material actionability, or their apparent difference disappears under the frozen interaction and domain summaries.
hypotheses.statement: Physics and frozen-model transformation-disagreement proxies can differ in spatial actionability because they expose different observable aspects of degradation while holding adapter capacity and alignment manipulation fixed.

hypotheses.discriminating_prediction: The selected proxy satisfies the seed and domain controls, its near-clear equal-domain lower bound is at least -0.05 dB, and every domain's near-clear and overall below--0.10 dB harm-prevalence upper bound is at most 0.10.
hypotheses.falsifier: The selected proxy has a decisive negative domain or seed effect, a near-clear mean upper bound below -0.05 dB, or a harm-prevalence lower bound above 0.10 in any domain.
hypotheses.statement: Any selected aligned-proxy gain repeats across seeds and domains and does not arise by sacrificing near-clear fidelity or creating a substantial negative tail relative to official ConvIR-B.

literature_basis.applicability_limit: NH-HAZE does not establish that either frozen proxy or this adapter is actionable, transferable, or safe.
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Spatially nonuniform haze is a real daytime-dehazing condition for which region-sensitive mechanisms and evaluation are scientifically relevant.

literature_basis.applicability_limit: The super-resolution result does not establish a dehazing effect or validate this factorial contrast.
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Aligned spatial side information can modulate intermediate restoration features through a conditional transform.

literature_basis.applicability_limit: Dark-channel exceptions remain, and the paper does not prove local correction direction or adapter utility.
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Dark-channel statistics motivate an observable physics-related haze proxy under stated scene assumptions.

literature_basis.applicability_limit: The publication does not validate horizontal-transformation disagreement, the frozen ConvIR-B proxy, or this route's thresholds.
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Observable prediction disagreement can motivate uncertainty-aware modulation and explicit risk evaluation in restoration.
